notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{C}.
You control at least one additional non-mana producing creature, or one of the mana-producing creatures has haste.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking another non-mana producing creature, or a mana-producing creature that has haste.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
